description: How many servings of a drink bring a person to a given blood alcohol level (e.g. "how many beers are 0.5 permille"), as a range: the low end assumes a 10 % resorption deficit and slow elimination, the high end 30 % and fast elimination. With hours_of_drinking > 0 the drinks are spread over that time and the level is the one reached at its end. Drink: an id from list_drinks, or ml + vol. Answers a question about amounts, never about whether driving is safe.
name: drinks_to_reach_permille
title: Drinks to reach a permille level
